title: Wilson–Davis meeting outside EG&G Las Vegas
place_text: EG&G special projects headquarters, Las Vegas

tellings.quote: A year after that, an infamous meeting would take place between scientist Eric Davis and Admiral Thomas Wilson, who oversaw basically all American military technology at the time.

plain: A scientist named Eric Davis and an admiral named Thomas Wilson, who Michels says "oversaw basically all American military technology at the time", are said to have held an "infamous meeting" outside the Las Vegas special projects headquarters of EG&G, a defense contractor, in the late 1990s or early 2000s. Michels describes it himself in an episode with a guest, without naming a source or saying here what was said. He tells it because, as the story goes in this subject, the meeting was about whether the military held secret programs on unexplained craft.
